categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.content: Meme coins native to Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: TRON Meme

categories.name: Binance Megadrop
categories.content: Binance Megadrop is an airdrop program by Binance. It allows users to earn rewards by subscribing to BNB to Locked Products and completing tasks within their Binance Web3 Wallet.

categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: Crypto-Backed Tokens
categories.content: Crypto-backed tokens are digital assets backed or collateralized by other cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins are excluded from this category and are classified separately under the Crypto-Backed Stablecoin category.

categories.name: DeFAI
categories.content: DeFAI or AIFI projects leverage AI to streamline and automate DeFi activities such as trading, staking, yield farming, market analysis, and investment optimization.

categories.name: Camelot Launchpad
categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Jupiter DTF Launchpad
categories.content: Jupiter Decentralized Token Formation (DTF) is a decentralized launchpad platform launched by Jupiter Exchange.

categories.name: Binance Wallet IDO
categories.content: Tokens and coins launched on Binance Wallet IDO.

categories.name: x402 Ecosystem
categories.content: x402 is an open protocol that defines an internet-native micropayment rail using HTTP 402 and stablecoins. It allows automated clients and AI agents to pay directly for APIs, data, and compute on demand, enabling real-time, low-friction transactions without intermediaries.

categories.name: Oracle
categories.content: Oracles are used by protocols in their smart contracts in order to obtain external data. This allows the closed-off blockchain environment to communicate with data points on the outside world. For example, a protocol offering synthetic Nasdaq-listed stock on the blockchain will need to pull external data from the stock market. With an oracle, the protocol will be able to do so.

categories.name: Cross-chain Communication
categories.content: Cross-chain communication allows different blockchain networks to interact and exchange data and assets.

categories.name: Elon Musk-Inspired
categories.content: Meme coins inspired by Elon Musk, none of these projects are (necessarily) endorsed or created by Elon Musk.

categories.name: Zodiac-Themed
